text: Everything in Tribal Power runs on **Pulse**, a living energy you make by keeping a rhythm, reading the land, or letting crystals and totems sing to each other.
This book follows a camp from its first drumbeat to machines that look after themselves. Turn the page with the arrows at the bottom, or the arrow keys.

pages.title: When a machine goes quiet
text: Crouch and right-click any Tribal Power block with this book in your hand. The block tells you what it is missing: power, a totem's voice, room in its output, or a redstone signal holding it paused.
That one habit answers most questions faster than any page can.
- **Blue words** are links to other pages.
- **Items** on a page can be clicked to open the page about them. Right-click opens JEI, if you have it.
- **Scenes** play a build step by step. Use the small arrows under a scene, and drag it to turn it around.
